news.headline: Apple fiscal Q4 earnings
news.facts: Revenue $114.5bn +12% YoY, diluted EPS $2.10 including $0.05 tariff refund, gross margin 47.9% including about 1pp tariff refunds. Reuters: iPhone $57.58bn, estimates $56.54bn.
news.taiwan_inference: iPhone supply chain and electronics assemblers sentiment; company-level orders and margins unverified; results not same as new orders.

news.headline: Marvell-Lumentum definitive agreement
news.facts: $115bn implied enterprise value, all stock, 4.5 Marvell shares per Lumentum share; expected H1 2028 subject to approvals; Nov 2 Marvell nearly -13%, Lumentum -18%.
news.taiwan_inference: AI optics, high-speed networking and PCB/CCL sentiment and competitive structure; proposed not closed, not proof of Taiwan orders or revenue.

news.headline: Taiwan October PMI slowed but remained expansionary
news.facts: 54.9 versus 56.7 in September; Dow Jones reports slower new order growth, AI components remained strong and supplier delays lengthened.
news.taiwan_inference: exporters and manufacturing supply chains face input/freight pressure; PMI >50 remains growth not contraction.

news.headline: Binance withdrawals and recovery
news.facts: Reuters reports company claim 95% of $6.3bn stolen assets covered; withdrawals phased; $3.64bn net Nov 1 in 9.5 hours.
news.taiwan_inference: crypto-linked risk sentiment and related exchange/cybersecurity exposures; no direct listed company order/revenue conclusion.
